stacks.label: Common
stacks.description: Workflow assets that apply to every technology stack.

profiles.label: JavaScript development
profiles.description: Node.js, package-manager, and TypeScript change guidance.
profiles.guidance: Use the repository's declared package manager and Node version. Inspect package scripts before changing dependencies, preserve lockfile consistency, and run the narrowest relevant typecheck, lint, and test commands.

profiles.label: .NET development
profiles.description: C#, SDK, project, and test guidance.
profiles.guidance: Use the repository's pinned .NET SDK and inspect solution and project files before changing dependencies. Keep package references consistent, run dotnet build and the smallest relevant dotnet test command, and report target-framework impact.

profiles.label: Safe changes
profiles.description: Guardrails for safe, focused repository changes.
profiles.guidance: Inspect the target and its callers first. Keep changes scoped, preserve unrelated work, and never use destructive Git commands without explicit approval.

profiles.label: Verification
profiles.guidance: Run the smallest relevant verification, report its result, and do not claim external state that was not inspected.

profiles.label: Pull-request review
profiles.description: Review specialist, workflow, and reusable prompt.
profiles.guidance: Inspect the diff and relevant callers. Report only actionable correctness, security, regression, and test-gap findings.

profiles.label: Debugging
profiles.guidance: Reproduce first, trace all callers of the shared boundary, isolate the root cause, and leave focused verification.

profiles.label: Handoff and grill me
profiles.description: Evidence-based handoff and adversarial readiness check.
profiles.guidance: State changed scope, verification, known gaps, and the next action. Challenge unsupported release claims.

profiles.label: Hook template
profiles.guidance: Enable hooks only when a deterministic lifecycle guard is required.

profiles.label: Session context hook
profiles.description: Inject repository context at Copilot CLI session start.
profiles.guidance: Read AGENTS.md and the installed Agent Distro instructions before changing files. Use the selected specialist assets when they match the task.

profiles.label: Verification reminder hook
profiles.description: Inject an evidence reminder at Copilot CLI session start.
profiles.guidance: Before handoff, run the smallest relevant check and report its result with any known gaps.
